assumptions.choice: Piercing pattern is defined as candle[-1] bearish (close < open), candle[0] bullish (close > open), open[0] < low[-1], and close[0] >= midpoint of candle[-1] real body. Bullish Engulfing is defined as candle[-1] bearish, candle[0] bullish, open[0] <= close[-1], and close[0] >= open[-1].
assumptions.reason: Follows the exact literal reading of the specification for both 2-candle reversal patterns.

assumptions.choice: Take-profit price reach threshold ($65.33) is evaluated against the bar's high price (high[0] >= 65.33).
assumptions.reason: The specification states 'When the price reaches the level $65.33', which in daily OHLC bar evaluation corresponds to the high price reaching or exceeding the level.

assumptions.choice: Once take-profit is reached, the trailing stop level is initialized to current 9-EMA and updated as max(previous_stop, current_ema), closing the position when close[0] < trailing_stop.
assumptions.reason: Matches the specification that the trailing stop automatically moves upward as price rises, maintaining a non-decreasing stop level based on the 9-EMA.

assumptions.choice: 50% position closing is issued via self.close(size=self.position.size * 0.5).
assumptions.reason: Accurately closes half of the current open position as specified.
